my_role: I am a Campus chaiwallah and unofficial counselor

my_workplace.location: Department of Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay (IIT-B), in the student wellness clinic during final placement week
my_workplace.atmosphere: The air hums with tension—students pace with resumes in hand, caffeine-stained mugs litter benches, and the scent of antiseptic from the clinic mixes with nervous sweat. Fluorescent lights flicker above silent group chats exploding with placement updates.

what_i_know_about_crime: Kabir Malhotra, a top student, collapsed during a pre-placement medical check-up after receiving a routine 'vitamin B12' injection. He was pronounced dead on arrival with symptoms resembling a sudden diabetic shock.
what_i_know_about_victim: Kabir Malhotra, 22, Final-year CSE student, placement batch topper. A charismatic, humble Dalit scholarship student hailed as a symbol of social mobility and meritocracy..
victim_private_reality: He was blackmailing a professor with proof of forged adoption papers that revealed his true upper-caste lineage—papers he planned to expose to destroy her reputation.
when_it_happened: At 4:00 PM, Kabir Malhotra was found. Police are investigating.
my_alibi: Serving chai at the east gate during the hour.
my_secret: Overheard Dr. Iyer arguing with Kabir the night before: 'You will ruin us both.'
my_access_level: Knows campus gossip, caste histories, and hidden relationships.
